serverInfo.description: Plans token swaps, cross-chain swaps and gas top-ups on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon and Optimism, and returns unsigned calls, or for a gas top-up one USDC authorization, for the user's wallet to sign. Each plan states its outcome kind and fallback first.
